sources.ref:aaker-1996: David A. Aaker, Building Strong Brands, Free Press, 1996. The brand identity system, and identity as something planned rather than found.
sources.ref:business-gov-au: Australian Government, business.gov.au, the business plan template and guide, the Australian form of the same outline.
sources.ref:ip-australia: IP Australia, Australian Trade Mark Search, and the Australian Securities and Investments Commission's Business Names Register. The two searches a name is cleared against.
sources.ref:mark-pearson-2001: Margaret Mark and Carol S. Pearson, The Hero and the Outlaw: Building Extraordinary Brands Through the Power of Archetypes, McGraw-Hill, 2001. The twelve archetypes and the discipline of choosing one.
sources.ref:neumeier-2006: Marty Neumeier, Zag: The Number One Strategy of High-Performance Brands, New Riders, 2006. The onliness statement: what the business alone is, for whom, and why.
sources.ref:nielsen-norman-2016: Kate Moran, The Four Dimensions of Tone of Voice, Nielsen Norman Group, 2016. Funny to serious, formal to casual, respectful to irreverent, enthusiastic to matter-of-fact.
sources.ref:ries-trout-1981: Al Ries and Jack Trout, Positioning: The Battle for Your Mind, McGraw-Hill, 1981. Positioning as the place a brand holds in the customer's mind against alternatives.
sources.ref:romaniuk-2018: Jenni Romaniuk, Building Distinctive Brand Assets, Oxford University Press, 2018. Which assets are worth owning and how recognition is measured.
sources.ref:sba: US Small Business Administration, Write your business plan, the traditional business plan outline the template's documents follow.
sources.ref:sharp-2010: Byron Sharp, How Brands Grow: What Marketers Don't Know, Oxford University Press, 2010. Distinctiveness over differentiation; consistency as the mechanism of recognition.
sources.ref:wheeler-2024: Alina Wheeler and Rob Meyerson, Designing Brand Identity, sixth edition, Wiley, 2024. The practitioner's process from research to a brand sheet, and what a reproducible identity specifies.
